lemmas.lean_skeleton: theorem toric_code_is_multiplicity_free : require_multiplicity_free (toric_code_fusion_ring()) = Ok (()) := by sorry
lemmas.statement: The 2x2 fusion ring of the toric code is multiplicity-free, validating the fusion_category replay for this topological data.
The unit laws for the toric code fusion category are repaired by the canonical gauge.
The Frobenius algebra identities replayed on matrices over Q(i) for dimension 1 to 16 do not require the specific Hopf algebra structure of QCD color composites.

open_obligations: Exact Frobenius matrix replay proof for dimensions 1 to 16 over Q(i)
Rigorous proof that the dimension cap 16 is a code bound and not a physical constraint on Q composites
Formalization of the 'refusal of degenerate trace forms' in the Frobenius replay logic
